description: IP Risk Detection RG: detection Patent Design API.

enableRadar.description: Whether to enable radar chart (AI infringement determination analysis)

imageUrl.description: Product image file URL, used for comparison with patent database, maximum 1000 characters

patentStatus.description: Patent validity filter: `1` (valid patent), `0` (invalidated patent), `1,0` (all), maximum 1000 characters

productDescription.description: Product description, used to supplement search context, maximum 1000 characters

productTitle.description: Product title, used to supplement search context, maximum 1000 characters

queryMode.description: Search mode: `physical` (physical drawing search), `line` (line drawing search), `hybrid` (mixed search), maximum 1000 characters

regions.description: The country/region codes where the product is sold, separated by commas when selecting multiple items. support `US`, `EU`, `CN`, `JP`, `KR`, `DE`, `GB`, `FR`, `IT`, `AU`, `CA`, `BR`, `MX`, `IN`, `TH`, `SE`, `CH`, `IE`, `IL`, `DK`, `NZ`, `AT`, `BX`, `FI`, `WO`, max. 1000 characters

sourceLanguage.description: The original language code needs to be marked for uniform translation into English, such as `zh-CN`; when the text is in English, just pass it empty, the maximum length is 1000 characters

topLoc.description: Specify the first-level LOC range to retrieve, such as `06,07`. The format is `^(0[1-9]\|1[0-9]\|2[0-9]\|3[0-2]\|ALL)(,(0[1-9]\|1[0-9]\|2[0-9]\|3[0-2]\|ALL))*$`; if not specified, use model LOC prediction results
